commitResults.messageTitle: Changed name and banner of bot to Carlo
commitResults.messageBody: Inspired by St Carlo Acutis! Who has been so close to me recently together with St Therese of Lisieux. "love always, wins!"

commitResults.messageTitle: Added Scanner for bot to echo input
commitResults.messageBody:
the bot now echos every input! terminate the bot by inputting "bye",
getting a nice farewell message before the code exits.

The bot now stores a list of the users inputs, then displays the list
when input = "list".
Added new class, methods such as mark and unmark tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Updated tasks to have certain deadlines
commitResults.messageBody: Tasks can now have deadlines and event times.
Tried to think of and cover each exception!

Changed Task list to array list to allow for more dynamic changes to the
list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Save tasks to hard disk and load on startup
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a Storage class that writes the task list to ./data/carlo.txt
after every command that changes it, and reads it back in when the
app starts. The data folder and file are created automatically if
missing, and lines that don't match the expected format are skipped
with a warning instead of crashing the app.

Also move Task, Todo, Deadline, Event, and CarloException into the
carlo.task and carlo.exception packages.

commitResults.messageTitle: Understand and display deadline/event dates and times
Extract Ui class for console I/O
commitResults.messageBody:
Move all System.out printing and Scanner-based input reading out of
Carlo.java into a new carlo.ui.Ui class. Carlo.java now delegates
display of greetings, help, task lists, and per-command confirmations
to Ui, keeping its own responsibility focused on command dispatch and
task manipulation. No behavior change; verified via manual smoke test
covering todo/deadline/event/list/mark/on/delete/bye and error paths.
